messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Separate matter - on the Okafor employment tribunal settlement, finance are asking when the agreed sum is due to be paid out and whether the COT3 has been finalised. Can you point me to whoever is handling that (I think it was the employment team, not you)? Sorry to land it on you.

Daniel
